Contact Us

How to reach the SimplyHow editorial team - corrections, questions, partnership enquiries and privacy requests.

Last updated: November 5, 2026

Before you write

The fastest answer to most questions is already on the site. Each guide includes a Frequently Asked Questions section and a table of contents, and you can search all 80+ guides with the search icon in the menu.

If you cannot find what you need, we would genuinely like to hear from you.

Email

Email: hello@simplyhow.example

(Replace this address in content/pages/contact.md with your real domain email before going live - a working inbox on your own domain is required for AdSense approval.)

To help us reply usefully, please include:

  • The URL of the guide you are writing about (if applicable)
  • What you were trying to do and where the steps failed
  • Your device, operating system or app version, when the issue is technical
  • Whether you are reporting a correction, a broken link, or asking a new question

What we answer, and how fast

| Type of message | What to expect | | --- | --- | | Corrections and broken steps | Verified and fixed first; we aim to update the guide within 7 days | | Questions about a guide | A reply from an editor, usually within 3 business days | | New guide requests | Added to our editorial backlog and reviewed monthly | | Privacy or data requests | Handled within 30 days as described in our Privacy Policy | | Partnership or advertising | Reply within 5 business days; we do not sell links or sponsored posts |

What we cannot do

  • We cannot provide one-to-one tech support, in-home repair or personal consulting.
  • We cannot answer medical, legal or financial questions - please consult a qualified professional.
  • We cannot guarantee a reply to every message, but every correction report is read.

Editorial independence

Advertising partners and affiliate programs have no influence over what we publish or how we rate anything. To learn how guides are researched and updated, read our Editorial Policy.

We do not accept payment for links, articles or rankings. Unsolicited promotional emails are deleted without a reply.
